topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: Introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: Explains how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages during cancer progression.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: Evaluates the cancer stem cell model and experimental evidence for how the cell of origin influences tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: Examines how inflammatory signals and supportive stromal microenvironments promote malignancy and can be targeted therapeutically.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: Describes the single-cell and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of factors driving cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: Integrates mutational, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: Concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
